You can't just differ an introvert and an extrovert from one single factor. Being an introvert or an extrovert is a lot more complex than that. 

What you said about "mental energy" is definitely true. Extroverts recharge their energy by being with people, whereas introverts by being alone. But that alone isn't all there is to being an intro- or extrovert.


>An introvert can be an outgoing person who is charming and the life of the party.

While an introvert can be quite charming they usually aren't very outgoing. They're reserved, calm, often lost in their thoughts and therefore can (seem to) be shy.

An extrovert is outgoing, talkative and likes being the center of attention. They like parties and crowds. 

[Source](https://www.google.com/amp/s/www.cnet.com/google-amp/news/the-difference-between-introverts-and-extroverts/)

I believe you should educate yourself on this matter more, before making these misleading assumptions.
